tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Shopify Entwickler/in (100% Remote)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my interest in the Shopify Entwickler/in position. With over 5 years of professional backend and e-commerce experience building and maintaining enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, and API integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing, and customer data management.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built RESTful APIs for headless commerce integrations and progressive web application frontends.

bullets.label: Integrations & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to keep product catalogs synchronized across global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Platform Operations
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on cloud portals within agile DevOps workflows, supported by production troubleshooting.

cover_en.gap: While my professional background is built on SAP Commerce Cloud rather than Shopify, I am a fast learner with deep e-commerce and backend development foundations and am very keen to learn Shopify development.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving my notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience can benefit your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Shopify Entwickler/in (100% Remote)
cover_de.hook: mit großem Interesse bewerbe ich mich auf die Position als Shopify Entwickler/in. Als Backend-Entwicklerin bringe ich über 5 Jahre professionelle Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Betreuung großer Enterprise-E-Commerce-Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell mit.

bullets.label: E-Commerce-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Entwickelt und implementiert habe ich Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud unter Verwendung von Java und Spring.

bullets.label: REST-APIs & Schnittstellen
bullets.text: Ausgearbeitet habe ich OCC-REST-Webdienste sowie RESTful APIs für Headless-Commerce-Integrationen und PWA-Frontends.

bullets.label: Datenintegrationen
bullets.text: Konzipiert und optimiert habe ich PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipeline-Prozesse mittels Profisee, Hotfoldern und DataHub.

bullets.label: CI/CD & DevOps
bullets.text: Ausgeführt habe ich CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen sowie Release-Builds auf Cloud-Portalen im Rahmen agiler Workflows.

cover_de.gap: Mein Schwerpunkt liegt bisher auf SAP Commerce Cloud, weshalb ich mich gerne in die spezifischen Anforderungen von Shopify einarbeiten möchte.
cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe und verfüge über eine gültige deutsche Aufenthalts- und Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 verfügbar bin. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I am motivated to join your remote e-commerce team because of your focus on modern digital platforms. My 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell have equipped me with strong skills in backend development, REST APIs, and system integrations that align with ambitious online retail projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend development expertise to your team while expanding my technical skill set.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, I am an experienced backend and e-commerce developer with 5+ years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, skilled in Java, Spring, and REST APIs. My last working day is Dec 15, 2026, and I am available from Dec 16. I would love to discuss your remote Shopify role.
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Shopify Entwickler/in position. With over 5 years of professional e-commerce development experience building enterprise platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong expertise in Java, Spring, REST APIs, and system integrations.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, serving notice until December 15, 2026, and available from December 16, 2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
